hand_set: leanG, leanN, adj_ed and paxton are set by hand; tools/update.py logs every change it makes to the rest.

log.text: Central no-primary lean set by hand from D +8.5 to D +3.3 (Saul, Nov. 1). The base, the 2024 Senate early-vote lean, recomputes to D +0.2 with Ryan's day-12 mix (was D +5.4 from the day-8 mix); the added shift stays about 3 points.

Paxton penalty set by hand from 0.5 to 4.0 points (Saul, Nov. 2). Final NYT/Siena Texas poll (Siena, Nov. 1): Talarico 50-43, Hinojosa 48-47, a 6-point Senate-governor gap; Abbott's own edge is 2. Down-ballot races unchanged.

Nov. 3: the final early-vote margin, D +24,763 through Oct. 30, replaced our estimate of D +30,000; the reliable-voter gap of 142,995 added 0.4 points. Our Senate read moved from Talarico +3.3 to Talarico +3.6.
